roles.detailed: Lead Frontend Developer | Fintech & Lending Platforms | React + Redux Toolkit

bio: Frontend Developer with 5+ years of experience designing and building scalable fintech and enterprise-grade applications. Currently leading frontend architecture for a configurable Loan Origination System (LOS) and Loan Management System (LMS) SaaS platform, architecting modular multi-tenant systems with React and Redux Toolkit. Experienced across underwriting workflows, Agentic AI integrations, CRM automation, and component-driven design systems for banking and lending products.

bullets: Designed and implemented 150+ reusable enterprise components for configurable Loan Origination (LOS) and Loan Management (LMS) platforms.
Built configurable modules for Risk Assessment Criteria, Credit Score models, Debt Burden Ratio, Total Credit Limit, and dynamic multi-level approval workflows.
Orchestrated an Agentic AI engine for contextual borrower engagement, chatbot-driven onboarding, and intelligent ticketing integration across the loan lifecycle.
Led frontend architecture decisions, code reviews, mentoring, and CRM/webhook integrations synchronizing borrower data with LMS in real time.
experience.desc: Leading frontend architecture for a configurable multi-tenant Loan Origination & Loan Management SaaS platform, spanning underwriting workflows, AI-assisted borrower engagement, and CRM automation.

bullets: Collaborated with UX/UI designers to enhance chatbot user experience.
Continuously improved chatbot understanding and response accuracy.
experience.desc: Chatbot UX collaboration and iterative improvement of conversational response quality.

bullets: Designed and developed new features and functions for client web applications.
Developed robust web apps using HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and React.
experience.desc: Feature development and robust web application delivery using the React ecosystem.

bullets: Tailored and crafted UI to meet specific client needs.
Ensured web functionality using HTML, CSS, JS & React.
experience.desc: Client UI delivery and cross-browser web functionality across HTML, CSS, JS, and React.
